program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-colors (grid-colors g))
                  (div-color (find (lambda (clr)
                                     (or
                                       (for/or ((r (range 0 h)))
                                               (for/and ((cc (range 0 w)))
                                                        (= (at g r cc) clr)))
                                       (for/or ((cc (range 0 w)))
                                               (for/and ((r (range 0 h)))
                                                        (= (at g r cc) clr)))))
                                   all-colors))
                  (cell-color (find (lambda (clr) (!= clr div-color)) all-colors))
                  (div-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                (for/and ((cc (range 0 w))) (= (at g r cc) div-color)))
                              r))
                  (div-cols (for/list ((cc (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r cc) div-color)))
                              cc))
                  (n-rows (let loop
                               ((divs (append (list -1) div-rows (list h))) (cnt 0))
                               (cond
                                 ((null? (cdr divs)) cnt)
                                 ((> (- (cadr divs) (car divs)) 1) (loop (cdr divs) (+ cnt 1)))
                                 (else (loop (cdr divs) cnt)))))
                  (n-cols (let loop
                               ((divs (append (list -1) div-cols (list w))) (cnt 0))
                               (cond
                                 ((null? (cdr divs)) cnt)
                                 ((> (- (cadr divs) (car divs)) 1) (loop (cdr divs) (+ cnt 1)))
                                 (else (loop (cdr divs) cnt))))))
             (build-grid n-rows n-cols (r c) cell-color)))))
